scope: Only new completed-hour coverage guard, scan status and supervisor forwarding; prior parser review not repeated

findings.title: Account for the existing 90-second source finalization before requiring the full receipt
findings.trigger: Every healthy current H1 at elapsed 60001..90000ms, before unchanged producer calls finish()
findings.defect: The entry-window-closed branch immediately opens receipt.json. Existing hour_stream deliberately continues through hour+90000 and main only calls s.finish afterwards. A missing receipt at +60s is therefore normal lifecycle, but the new guard raises and selected_tick reports BLOCKED_NEW_INPUTS; existing owner health marks any BLOCKED status unhealthy.
evidence: scripts/run_pump4_stream_v1.py:125-127 calls finish only after hour_stream returns
tests/test_pump4_current_hour_coverage_v1.py missing_receipt case passes by raising at hour+60001
findings.remediation: Distinguish closed entry window/source finalization pending from failed completed coverage using an explicit bounded settlement interval consistent with existing producer. Keep the 60-second entry deadline unchanged, and block when the bounded completion deadline is missed or a completed receipt fails.

findings.title: Accept source-proven unavailable instruments with non-trading metadata
findings.trigger: A frozen-universe instrument remains in metadata with status Settled or another producer-defined unavailable condition
findings.defect: The guard accepts UNAVAILABLE_INSTRUMENT only when instrument is exactly None. The existing producer explicitly stores the nonempty instrument dict for non-Trading/wrong quote/wrong contract instruments and includes such rows in a passing full-hour receipt. A valid unavailable instrument therefore makes every completed H1 BLOCKED even though source coverage passed.
evidence: research_lab/pump4_stream_intake_v1.py:35-38 producer emits UNAVAILABLE_INSTRUMENT with original instrument value
research_lab/pump4_stream_intake_v1.py:116 hour_pass accepts UNAVAILABLE_INSTRUMENT regardless of null metadata

Bounded standalone reproducer: status Settled, quoteCoin USDT, contractType LinearPerpetual yields producer_emits_unavailable=true, producer_finish_accepts_status=true, guard raises PUMP4_RUNTIME_SOURCE_CURRENT_HOUR_INSTRUMENT_COVERAGE
findings.remediation: Validate the existing producer unavailable predicate and instrument symbol/scope instead of demanding null; continue rejecting a Trading/USDT/LinearPerpetual instrument falsely marked unavailable.

custody_review: selected_tick still reconciles admitted lifecycle before calling candidate; forwarding only rewrites NO_NEW_SIGNAL, no custody ordering regression found
